verdict.rationale: An in-browser toolbar is a fair question for a deployment and hosting platform like Workers. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a toolbar, on-site feedback, feature-flag management or in-page performance inspection. The built-in observability is a separate logs feature and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage feature flags, and inspect performance directly on my live site
